paper.title: LLMs Get Lost In Multi-Turn Conversation
paper.arxiv_title: LLMs Get Lost In Multi-Turn Conversation

source.caption: In this work, we simulate single- and multi-turn conversations for six generation tasks. The 15 LLMs we test perform much worse in multi-turn settings (-35\%) explained by some loss in aptitude, and large losses in reliability. Aptitude is defined as performance in best-case conversation simulation, and unreliability as the gap between best- and worst-case performance. In short, we find that LLMs get lost in multi-turn, underspecified conversation.
